name: trek-iq
description: Accessibility-focused routing and data visualization web app for Halifax

scripts.build: echo 'Using pre-built client files' && npm run copy:build
scripts.copy:build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');if(!fs.existsSync('public'))fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});const src='client/build';const dest='public';fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Client build files copied successfully');"
scripts.build:full: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && npm run copy:build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install

author: Trek.IQ Team
